introCard.title: What are SwitchWords?
introCard.body: SwitchWords are short words or phrases used as focus triggers.You repeat one with a clear intention to support a specific need.

steps.title: Pick a need
steps.detail: Choose what you want support with, like calm or focus.

steps.title: Repeat the word
steps.detail: Say it slowly, aloud or silently, several times.

steps.title: Visualize and feel it
steps.detail: Picture the result and stay with that feeling.

faqs.question: How often should I use a switch word?
faqs.answer: Once or twice a day is a good start.

faqs.question: Can I use more than one?
faqs.answer: Yes, but focus on one need at a time.

faqs.question: When is the best time?
faqs.answer: Mornings and before sleep work well for many people.

introCard.title: What are Sacred Codes?
introCard.body: Sacred codes are number sequences to focus your mind and align your energy for manifestation.

steps.title: Set Your Intention
steps.detail: State clearly what you want to manifest or achieve.

steps.title: Repeat The Code 45 Times
steps.detail: Say the exact number 45 times (e.g., Code 520 for Money). | | You can say it out loud, silently, or break down digits | | (Five-Two-Zero or Five Hundred and Twenty).

steps.title: Use A Counting String
steps.detail: Use a necklace or bracelet with 45 beads to stay on track | | without losing focus by counting manually.

steps.title: Close With Gratitude
steps.detail: Seal the intention by saying: "Thank you, it is done."
